name: Aurelia Solitaire Ring
description: Built around a single round-brilliant diamond of 0.72 carat, set in 18-karat yellow gold. The gallery is pierced by hand so light reaches the pavilion from beneath.

name: Vesper Illusion Studs
description: Set in the house illusion style: a faceted white-gold plate extends the visual spread of the diamonds well beyond their carat weight.

name: Lumen Tennis Bracelet
description: Forty-two round brilliants totalling 3.10 carat, articulated individually so the line follows the wrist. Concealed box clasp with a double catch.
